title: Rageblade on the shooter
prompt: Stage 2-3. You combined a Recurve Bow and a Needlessly Large Rod into Guinsoo's Rageblade. Who holds it?
explanation:
Rageblade gives stacking attack speed for every attack. It wants the unit that attacks the most and lives the longest: a ranged auto-attacker in the back row. Varus is a Rapidfire, whose trait already gains attack speed per attack, and he is your only backline attacker.

Ornn and Kobuko are frontliners who want armour and health. Karma is a caster: she wants mana and ability power, not attack speed. Attack items on tanks are the most common item leak at this level.
principle: Attack-speed items go on the ranged auto-attacker. Tanks get tank items.
commonMistake: Giving the item to the unit with the most health because it feels safer.
